# Just Gone Wandering

> > A personal travel blog documenting journeys across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, with a focus on UNESCO World Heritage Sites, cruise travel, and train adventures.

Just Gone Wandering chronicles the author's global travels, featuring detailed itineraries and travel logs from destinations including Scotland, England, France, and cross-country train trips like the Southwest Chief. The site serves as both a personal travel journal and a reference for UNESCO World Heritage Sites and GeoParks visited worldwide.

## Key Topics

- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Europe travel
- UK travel (Scotland, England)
- France
- Train travel (Southwest Chief)
- Cruise travel
- Historical and ancient sites
- Cultural heritage
- Travel itineraries
- Chicago and Fort Lauderdale
- Asia travel
- GeoParks
- First-time international travel
- Travel logs and collections

## UNESCO World Heritage & Cultural Sites

- [UNESCO World Heritage Sites & GeoParks](https://justgonewandering.com/unesco-world-heritage): Collection of UNESCO World Heritage Sites and GeoParks visited worldwide

- [Where I've Been (2022)](https://justgonewandering.com/where-ive-been-2022): 2022 travel log covering Europe, UK, France, and Southwest Chief train trip
